This directory contains the minimum AMD FidelityFX FSR 1.0.2 shader sources used by the separate native proof-of-concept.

Upstream: https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR
Pinned upstream commit: `a21ffb8f6c13233ba336352bdff293894c706575`
Upstream sample wrapper: `sample/src/DX12/FSR_Pass.hlsl`
Copied files: `ffx_a.h`, `ffx_fsr1.h`, `FSR_Pass.hlsl`, `FSR1_LICENSE.txt`.

The AMD files are retained with their original copyright and license headers. `ffx_a.h` also contains its additional third-party attribution/license text. Do not remove these notices. No NVIDIA runtime or proprietary binary is included.
